findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: A jug of milk was observed not properly date marked in the standing cooler closest to the dish room in the kitchen. Discussed with the PIC. The PIC told inspectors that the jug was opened on Tuesday (9/1/2026). Education was provided. The jug of milk was dated. Ensure that all food items are date marked appropriately at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (A) Except when PACKAGING FOOD using a REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING method as specified under § 3-502.12, and except as specified in (E) and (F) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The trash bin in the employee bathroom was observed without a lid. The bathroom is a unisex facility. The PIC was made aware. The PIC replaced the trash bin with a covered bin. Ensure that the bin in any unisex bathroom/facility has a lid.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The coving on the left and back walls in the storage room by the stove was observed missing. The PIC was made aware. The PIC assured inspectors that the relevant repairs would be done. Ensure that the coving is installed sealing the walls and preventing pest entry.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.13(A) Floor and Wall Junctures, Coved, and Enclosed or Sealed. (A) In FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS in which cleaning methods other than water flushing are used for cleaning floors, the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1 mm (one thirty-second inch).

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Mouse droppings were observed in multiple locations and corners within the kitchen and dry storage areas during today’s inspection. PIC told inspector that they have been having issues with mouse for some time now. However, they are working with maintenance to combat the mouse situation. PIC told inspector that they will continue to monitor and take the necessary measures to eradicate the mouse situation. Ensure that the necessary actions are taken to reduce and eradicate pest activities within the facility.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 Inspector observed a staff member not washing their hands at the hand sink before donning gloves and starting food prep. Staff had just come out of the bathroom and touched the door handle with their bare hands. Education was carried out and the behavior was corrected. Ensure that staff practice adequate handwashing before donning gloves during food prep. 


When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed multiple ants and a live roach in the dry storages area and mouse droppings in multiple areas in the kitchen and the dry storages area. PIC was made aware of pest activities in the facility. Per PIC, the pest control technician comes every two months. PIC ensured inspectors that they will make arrangements for the pest control technician to have a more frequent visit to the facility. Ensure that facility is routinely monitored for pest activities and the relevant action taken to eliminate pests in the facility.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The fan in use by the dish machine is observed to have a slight accumulation of dust/debris. Ensure the current accumulation of dust/debris is cleaned and then ensure this fan is cleaned at a freqeuncy necessary to maintain it clean.  
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The top of the dish machine is observed to have a build-up of hard water residue. Ensure the top of the dish machine and its surrounding components are thoroughly cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.  
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The shelving in the dry storage room is observed to have an excessive amount of corrosion/rust. These shelving units need to be resealed to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface or need to be replaced with new shelving that is smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The air duct above the dish machine is observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil buildup. These surfaces need to be cleaned and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The dish machine is observed in a state of disrepair. The school received a new dish machine on Wednesday with no foreseeable deadline for the completion of the installation of the dish machine to make it functional and able to sanitize the equipment. Ensure that installation is done properly and to manufacturer specifications for functionality. Staff is utilizing the Triple Sink as a temporary solution at this time.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-204.117: The dish machine is observed in a state of inoperability due to its recent incomplete installation and therefore is unable to dispense sanitizer. This machine must be installed to manufacturer specifications to allow for optimal operability after installation is completed.  
WAREWASHING MACHINE, after adoption of Code, shall be equipped to: (A) automatically dispense detergents and SANITIZERS, (B) incorporate visual means to verify delivery of chemicals.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The face being used in the dish room is observed to have a slight accumulation of dust/soil residue. Ensure the surfaces of the fan, when used within the kitchen, are cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of soil/residue. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There are pipes observed in the dish area that come through the metal wall of the table. These pipes have gaps around them that are in need of being sealed. Ensure this repair is made to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Used test strips on the sanitizer bucket and it read 0ppm for the sanitizer bucket with bleach. Asked CFM about the bucket concentration and she said it was made at 5:25am and has not been tested since. Education was given to the staff about checking the concentration every few hours to ensure its integrity. The sanitizer bucket was refilled and brought up to 200ppm bleach sanitizer solution.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: Observed caulking of the triple sink and the dish machine to be in need of replacement. Ensure this seal is replaced to allow for the surface to be smooth, non-absorbent and easily cleanable.
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed mouse droppings on an empty tray in the dry storage room and on two bottom shelves in the wall storage cabinets. Clean these areas and continue to monitor for pests. District pest control was on site  yesterday to address the pest issue and staff is knowledgeable in cleaning and sanitizing of surfaces and frequency at which to do so.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
The two sets of blue double doors directly up the stairs from the cafeteria/kitchen have 1/2-1 inch gaps at the bottom of the doors where sunlight clearly shines through and mice can easily enter the facility. Seal doors so that they are protecting from rodent entry.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.
